items.source: This is a method-level annotation that can be combined with a type-level @MessageMapping for a combined route pattern. It supports the same arguments as @MessageMapping but the return value must be void. On a server, handling can be asynchronous (for example, Mono<Void>), in which case the connection is accepted if and when the Mono<Void> completes. On the client side this method is only a callback and does not affect the establishment of the connection.
items.translation: 这是一个方法级注解，可与类型级@MessageMapping组合以形成组合路由模式。它支持与@MessageMapping相同的参数，但返回值必须是void。在服务器上，处理可以是异步的（例如，Mono<Void>），在这种情况下，仅当Mono<Void>完成时才会接受连接。在客户端，此方法仅作为回调，不影响连接的建立。

items.source: Depending on the configured RouteMatcher, the pattern may be AntPathMatcher or PathPattern based.
items.translation: 根据配置的 RouteMatcher，该模式可能基于 AntPathMatcher 或 PathPattern。

items.source: Note: an @ConnectMapping method may start requests to the remote through an RSocketRequester method argument, but it must do so independent of the handling thread (for example, via subscribing on a different thread).
items.translation: 注意：@ConnectMapping 方法可以通过RSocketRequester方法参数发起对远程的请求，但必须独立于处理线程执行（例如，通过在其他线程上订阅）。

items.source: By default this is an empty array in which case it matches all ConnectionSetupPayload and metadata pushes.
items.translation: 默认情况下，这是一个空数组，在这种情况下它将匹配所有 `ConnectionSetupPayload` 和元数据推送。

items.source: Mappings expressed by this annotation to match to the route from the metadata of the initial ConnectionSetupPayload or in subsequent metadata pushes.
items.translation: 由该注解表达的映射，用于与初始 `<code>ConnectionSetupPayload` 的元数据或后续元数据推送中的路由进行匹配。
